title: Quality Engineer
description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network-combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

- Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

- Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

- Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

- Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

QUALIFICATIONS (PREFERRED):

- Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 3-5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

- Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

- Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

- Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

- Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

- ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

- Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

- Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

title: Customer Success Manager - General Contractor Customers
description:
The Role
Clearstory is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of general contractor accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth. You will report to the Manager of Customer Success and work as an individual contributor with a mixed book of enterprise and mid-market GCs. Our GC customer base is growing and each CSM already carries 20 to 40 accounts, so we need another owner to work every account well.
If you have run change orders as a PM or PE at a general contractor and want to move into tech, this role is for you.
What You’ll Own

•
A book of GC accounts. You inherit existing accounts and implement newly sold logos. The book ramps through your first year and reaches 1 to 3 million in ARR in year two, depending on lifecycle stage.

•
Retention and forecasting. Keep your accounts live and renewing by working each one to our written standards, without reminders, and forecast renewals for your own accounts.

•
New GC implementations . Lead post-sale implementation and Project Team Training for net new GCs, so project teams are live and receiving change orders and T&M tags in Clearstory .

•
Adoption. Run check-ins and trainings so field and office users keep using the platform and see the impact.

•
Customer success tools. Use business reviews and other customer success tools to drive retention, adoption, and growth in your accounts.

•
Referrals and growth. Ask for referrals at the right moments and find expansion inside the accounts you own, such as new projects, offices, and additional users. Hand both to the account executive, so your accounts lead to new projects, offices, and companies.

•
Work with Product. Work cross-functionally with the Product team, bringing customer feedback into feature request reviews so what we build matches how GCs work.

What This Role Is Not
This is an individual contributor role. It is not a people manager role and it is not pre-sales. We already have written standards for working each account. Your job is to run them well and raise the bar.
About You
You have worked the general contractor side of change orders, so you know how contracts, budgets, and owner billing work, and you can meet a customer’s situation with one you have lived. You run our standards and practices without handholding or reminders, then improve on them. As an individual contributor, you inspire and motivate the team through your own success, as we cheer each other on and learn from each other. Moving from the field is a real shift, and you will manage your time across many accounts while you learn the role.
The Company You’ll Join
Clearstory is digitizing and automating the change order process inside the commercial construction industry.
Just as TurboTax did for tax documents and Expensify did for receipts and expense reports, Clearstory is doing the same for change order communication and log management by building first-of-its-kind, category defining software that is revolutionizing the commercial construction industry.
The construction industry is being transformed fast by technology, but the way companies communicate costs hasn’t evolved in decades and still heavily relies on carbon copy paper, spreadsheets and email to track billions of dollars. These arcane manual processes can take days or weeks and include hours of manual office tasks such as scanning, manually transcribing, and tedious data-entry into spreadsheets.
At Clearstory we are changing that and creating a new category “change order communication,” by intelligently digitizing this age-old process. This leads to an increase in profits, more successful contractor to customer relationships, more transparency into a project’s true cost, and less wasted paper!
We are a venture backed 100% SaaS company with impressive credentials for a company at our stage.

• Blue Chip Clients. We have already landed some of the largest General and Subcontractors in the US and have helped our clients build landmark projects.

• Significant Growth.

title: SDR Manager APAC - Sydney

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship.

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge.

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20,000 customers and supports approximately 300,000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1.5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

You will build and run Sales Development across Asia-Pacific. You will lead the APAC team and own its strategy: segmentation, org design and investment trade-offs, tied to the global revenue plan.

APAC is not one market. ANZ, India, Southeast Asia, Japan and Korea differ in language, buying norms, deal size and channel mix. Your job is to build one operating system that holds the standard across all of them and adapts where the market requires it.

- Write the APAC Sales Development strategy: segmentation by country and segment, org design, and where to invest first. Tie it to the global revenue plan and to peer regions.

Principal Consultant - Finance Transformation

Location: Edinburgh or Glasgow (Hybrid) |  Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent

Empower finance leadership through strategic transformation

The Role

Capco is looking for Principal Consultants to join our growing Finance Transformation capability within the Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime (FRRF) practice. You'll play a key role in helping CFOs, Treasurers, and senior finance leaders maximise the value of their finance and treasury functions through operating model redesign, process transformation, and strategic technology delivery. You'll also leverage approved AI tools and AI-enabled ways of working to improve analysis, accelerate insight generation, and enhance delivery while applying responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight.

What You'll Do

• Deliver finance transformation programmes spanning regulatory change (including Basel, IFRS, and PRA), finance technology, process optimisation, and operating model transformation, identifying opportunities to leverage AI-enabled workflows and automation.

• Partner with CFOs, Treasurers, and C-suite stakeholders to implement finance strategies, strengthen controls, and optimise regulatory reporting, including ICAAP, ILAAP, and Recovery and Resolution Planning (RRP).

• Define business requirements and manage end-to-end project delivery across finance, treasury, and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring appropriate governance where AI-assisted tools are utilised.

• Design and implement stress testing frameworks across credit, market, and liquidity risk to support regulatory compliance and strategic decision-making, using AI-enabled analysis where appropriate.

• Collaborate with technology teams to embed digital, automation, and AI-enabled solutions into finance processes, architecture, and operating models to improve efficiency and business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

• Experience delivering finance transformation programmes within financial services or management consulting.

• Strong understanding of finance operating models, accounting processes, regulatory change, and financial reporting.

• Experience with finance technology implementations, including ERP platforms, subledgers, automation, and optimisation solutions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using approved AI tools to enhance analysis, productivity, and decision-making while maintaining sound professional judgement.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence audiences from project teams through to CFOs and executive leadership.

Bonus Points For

• Professional finance qualification such as ACA, ACCA, or CIMA.

• Familiarity with Basel, Solvency II, IFRS, SOX, PRA, or EBA regulatory requirements.

• Experience delivering finance transformation programmes involving RPA, cloud technologies, AI-enabled solutions, or Generative AI within finance functions.

• Strong business analysis or project management credentials such as Agile, PMI, or PRINCE2.

• Experience supporting business development, proposition development, leadership initiatives, or client growth.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact transformation programmes for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, industry certifications, and structured career development.

• Help shape the future of finance transformation through innovation, automation, and technology.

• Be part of a team delivering meaningful change across financial services and energy.

Benefits

• Core Benefits: Discretionary bonus, competitive pension, health insurance, life insurance and critical illness cover.

• Mental Health: Easy access to CareFirst, Unmind, Aviva consultations, and in-house first aiders.

• Family-Friendly: Maternity, adoption, shared parental leave, plus paid leave

title: Delivery Engineer, ML, EMEA
description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The Mission: Turn Ground Truth Into Growth
Hilbert has two parts: a data foundation that gives our AI agents a high-fidelity view of each business, and an agentic web app where growth teams find and act on insights. The scores and audiences you build feed both: our agents reason with them, and our activation sends them into paid media and CRM.

The hard problem

Every customer's data is different, their compute may be ClickHouse, Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery, and their teams want proof, not promises. Your models have to work in that environment and show measured uplift. We want every pod to stay lean and efficient across very different customer environments, delivering quality work at startup speed. You focus on delivery; our sales engineers handle pre-sales. Your work centers on customers in your own region: supporting customers elsewhere is a rare exception, and your global work is mainly staying aligned with Hilbert colleagues in other regions.

What you'll do

•
Feature stores: build customer-specific, point-in-time correct features on the data foundation.

•
Models: train, tune and validate propensity, churn, lifetime value, uplift and custom models, starting from our ML templates and building custom models when a customer needs something the templates don't cover. New model types that many customers will need are built first by our product engineering team, and you roll them out to later customers.

•
Model analysis: go beyond aggregate metrics to verify what each model has learned, what drives its scores, and how it behaves across segments and on edge cases.

•
Deployment: models run in the customer's own environment or on our managed stack. In either case, understand the constraints, pin down the requirements, design the ML system to fit, and write the scores and audiences our agents and activation use.

•
Measurement: own the statistical design inside our growth team's measurement plan, from power and holdout setup to uplift analysis.

•
Trust: document models for the customer's data science and risk teams, then monitor and retrain them in production.

•
Productization: turn repeated features and model patterns into product with our product engineering team.

What success looks like

• Audiences built from your models lift the agreed growth metric, such as conversion or retention, against a holdout group, and that result decides whether the customer takes them to production.

Who you are

•
The translator: you explain a model to a customer's data science team and earn their trust.

•
The experimenter: you'd rather prove uplift in a holdout test than show off an offline metric.

•
The pilot: you get the most out of AI agents across model iterations, from feature ideas and experiment runs to error analysis, and help build them into how the team works.

•
The systems thinker: you build reusable features, pipelines and automation instead of one-off models, so a small team can deliver across very different environments.

• Extensive applied ML experience on tabular customer data, with strong Python and ML libraries.

• Extensive hands-on deep learning experience, from designing architectures and loss functions to training and shipping models in production, with PyTorch or a similar framework.

• Feature engineering in SQL warehouses such as Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery.

• Working data engineering experience: building and debugging pipelines, data orchestration, data modeling and data quality checks, enough to own your feature pipelines end to end with

title: Data Engineer
description:
Why This Role Exists
A2Z Sync runs the deal for dealership rooftops across the United States: digital retail, desking, F&I, and in-store operations on one platform. Every one of those transactions, and every integration with the DMS, CRM, and lender systems around it, produces data. Today that data runs on AWS, from dealer system integrations through an Athena semantic layer to the reports our teams and partners rely on every day.
Now we are building A2Z 2.0, an AI-driven data and intelligence platform for dealers, on a new lakehouse. The agents and insights it delivers are only as good as the data underneath them: fresh, modeled, governed, and fast. That is the Data Engineer's job. You will architect, build, and operate the analytical data ecosystem that feeds reporting today and the intelligence platform tomorrow, with the reliability that a showroom floor demands.
This is a builder's role on a small team. You will own pipelines end to end, from ingestion to the models analysts and agents query, and you will be in the room when the platform's data decisions get made.
Scope & Scale

• Thousands of dealer tenants on the platform, each with isolated databases and per-tenant configuration.

• Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi-protocol vendor connectivity (REST, SOAP, event-driven).

• An Athena semantic layer of 40+ views feeding Power BI reports and the A2Z Insights self-serve app, used by Product, Ops, Engineering, IT, Finance, and strategic partners.

• A new dealer lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold on Iceberg) coming online for A2Z 2.0, with Beta this fall and general availability early next year.

• Production AI agents whose tools and context depend on the data you serve.

What You'll Own

•
Data workloads on AWS. Architect, build, and operationalize pipelines and storage using Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and, where the workload calls for it, Timestream, Flink, and Kafka.

•
The lakehouse. Bronze, silver, and gold layers on Iceberg: table design, partitioning, compaction, and the storage-format decisions (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC) that keep queries fast as data grows.

•
Data models and access. Models that analysts, reports, and agents can trust; secure data access APIs in Java and/or Python; real-time streaming where the use case earns it.

•
Pipeline reliability. Monitoring, alerting, logging, and freshness and completeness checks, so breaks are caught before the Data and BI Analyst or a dealer sees them.

•
Anomaly detection and data quality. Statistical and ML-based monitoring of data quality and integration call volumes, so a spike, drop, or silent failure surfaces early.

•
Forecasting and predictive features. Model development in Python (scikit-learn, pandas, numpy) for forecasting and predictive analytics that feed A2Z 2.0 insights.

•
Governance and security. SSL/TLS, client authentication, access auditing, and the controls that keep dealer data inside its tenant.

•
Cross-functional delivery. Working with engineers, product managers, and the Data and BI Analyst to turn data requirements into scalable, secure, high-quality solutions.

First 90 Days / First Year
First 90 Days: Learn the platform, the integration domains, and the semantic layer well enough to trace any reported number to its source. Take ownership of the pipelines feeding reporting and add freshness and completeness checks where they are missing. Ship your first production change to the lakehouse. Publish a point of view on the ingestion and modeling patterns A2Z 2.0 should standardize on.
First Year: The A2Z 2.0 lakehouse is in production with bronze, silver, and gold layers you built or hardened, serving reports and agents at GA. Pipeline incidents are caught by your monitoring before users report them. At least one forecasting or anomaly-detection model is live and used in the product or in operations. The patterns you set are the ones the next data engineer inherits.

title: Senior Project Manager

About the role
Isos Technology is looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead our most complex, multi-client delivery within the professional services practice. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a PM who can own our highest-stakes engagements, set the standard for how we deliver, and raise the capability of the PMs around them.
At Isos, seniority isn’t about time in seat. We level on scope, complexity, influence, and sustained impact - not tenure. A Senior PM consistently operates at a higher level of complexity, carries our most demanding client relationships, and can be trusted to deliver in ambiguity without a playbook handed to them.
What you’ll do

• Lead delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements, owning scope, schedule, budget, risk, and stakeholders on each.

• Take on the toughest, highest-visibility projects in the portfolio - the ones with the most moving parts, the most senior client stakeholders, or the most delivery risk.

• Act as a consultative partner to clients, not just a coordinator - anticipating problems, guiding decisions, and protecting the outcome.

• Set and hold delivery standards: consistent use of our internal processes, tooling, and artifacts (backlogs, schedules, status, governance) so quality doesn’t depend on who’s assigned.

• Mentor and level up other PMs and delivery team members; serve as an SME and a model for how the role is done well.

• Manage to your [billable/utilization target] while balancing the demands of several clients at once.

What sets a Senior PM apart (how we level)
Because we don’t level on tenure, these are the differentiators we look for:

• Scope & complexity - you regularly run engagements of significant size, complexity, and stakeholder difficulty, and you’ve done it across a meaningful number of projects, not just once.

• Multi-client capability (required) - you handle multiple clients simultaneously, with the context-switching, prioritization, and range that demands. Deeply dedicated single-client portfolio leadership is the Program Manager lane, not Senior PM.

• Influence - you shape how we deliver, not just what gets delivered; other PMs and consultants are better because of how you work.

• Consultative judgment - clients trust you with decisions, not just task tracking.

• Order under ambiguity - you bring structure without needing everything pre-built for you.

Requirements

• 6 years of project management experience in professional services or consulting delivery, including 6 years running multiple concurrent client engagements.

• Demonstrated success leading complex, high-risk, or high-visibility projects to successful outcomes.

• Strong command of both traditional and agile delivery (backlog management, iteration planning, product-owner collaboration).

• Fluency in our delivery tooling ([Jira, Confluence]) and a track record of following and enforcing standard delivery processes.

• Comfort in a lean, fast-changing environment - building what isn’t there rather than waiting for structure.

Preferred certifications & accreditations

• PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent

• Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or comparable agile credential

• Atlassian accreditations ([Jira, Confluence, relevant technical accreditations])

• Relevant AI-delivery or tooling accreditations

Who thrives here
Isos is a lean, fast-evolving practice. The people who do best embrace ambiguity, treat gaps as a chance to put their mark on something rather than a problem handed to them, and can hold structure and flexibility in the same hand. If you need every process defined before you can move, this won’t be the right fit. If you like bringing order to a little healthy chaos, you’ll do well here.
